arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 6000 m, 4.8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. CP from test: shaft 184 W, W prime 13.8 kJ; boat 124 W. For ~30 min race target shaft about 190 W (CP + Wprime/T). Start hot (shaft 247 W, pod reserve 72 pct). Let start settle; if shaft stays above ~200 W past 3 min, cue hold. Current +0.3 m/s along leg 1 (outbound), expect headwind/current on return legs: boat-speed reserve numbers will mislead there; trust pod (w_bal_pod_frac). Check CP calibration (10-25 pct off) by watching pod reserve vs feel.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 35 pct with more than 1500 m left
GPS speed well below what pod power should give beyond current: possible weed on rudder or drag

arguments.text: Into the current now, lift a touch, hold 2:55 pace

7 min, 1463 m, leg 2 (against current -0.36 m/s): shaft 185 W (sustainable 189), pod reserve 53 pct, fade -2.2 pct. Paddler says effort 4/10, plenty left: possible sign CP underestimated (or overconfidence). Cued push to 2:55/500 over ground (~192 W shaft) to spend a bit more into the current; plan to hold/ease near CP on the helping legs (odd legs). Check after: did pod reserve drop too fast? If paddler holds 190+ with little fade by 15 min, consider raising cp_shaft.

Pod reserve 38 pct, shaft 193 W but sustainable now about 186-187 W for the longer race. Next: after turn at 2500 m cue hold near 2:30-2:32 ground pace on helping leg (~185 W shaft). Legs: turns at 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250; finish 7250 (outbound/helping legs are odd: 1,3,5; last 1000 m is leg 6, against current?). Check heading at the end.

arguments.text: Clear the rudder: one back-stroke, then straight back to pace

22.9 min, 4383 m, leg 4: paddler effort 3/10 but says boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Boat power per shaft watt fell from ~0.72 (3-5 min) to ~0.65 now, fade -3.7 pct: consistent with slow drag build-up (weed) that eta_est absorbed, so drag_jump watch never fired. Cued clear_rudder at 23 min. CHECK next wake-up: if push_local rises above push_along by 0.1+ and fade improves, it was weed; if not, it is fatigue. Pod reserve 29 pct, sustainable 188 W.

Plan: leg 5 (helping) hold 2:24 ground (~184 W, at CP); leg 6 (6250-7250 against) hold ~2:55-2:57 then finish cue at ~6850-6900 m (350-400 m out) to empty the reserve. If boat starts feeling heavy again (fade worsens past -4), consider another clear.
